argv: root=$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD); echo "root=$root"; for p in tools/mutate-and-run.sh SHONEN.md SKILL.md corpus/SOURCES.md; do if git cat-file -e "$root:$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "present $p"; else echo "absent $p"; fi; done; echo "--- assemble.py history"; git log --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -- .ufo/evidence/round-16/coldread/assemble.py; echo "--- measure.py history"; git log --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -- .ufo/evidence/round-16/measure.py; echo "--- reattribute.py history"; git log --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -- .ufo/evidence/round-16/attribution/reattribute.py
